fine_trace.note: Attacker-controlled first byte selects the disassembly platform from the platforms array.
The selected platform's architecture and mode are used to open a capstone handle.

fine_trace.code: size_t count = cs_disasm(handle, Data+1, Size-1, address, 0, &all_insn);
fine_trace.note: The remaining input bytes are disassembled; the disassembler decodes instructions and populates MCInst operands.
MCInst_Init sets only the Kind field of each operand to kInvalid, leaving the union value (RegVal/ImmVal/FPImmVal) uninitialized.
When a register operand is created, only Kind and RegVal are set; the union's ImmVal member remains uninitialized.
If an operand created as a register is later read as an immediate, the uninitialized ImmVal union member is returned.
The fuzz target reads disassembled instruction details, and the uninitialized operand value propagates into the detail structure, triggering the MSan use-of-uninitialized-value report.
